note: 인쇄물 템플릿이 쓰는 생성 그림. 이 파일이 원본이고, scripts/print-art.mjs 가 이것만 보고 그림을 만듭니다. width/height/bytes 는 만든 뒤 스크립트가 적어 넣습니다. 자세한 규칙은 docs/print-templates.md.
suffix: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signage. Leave generous empty space for typography. Clean edges, no border, no frame, full-bleed composition. Print quality, natural colours, no oversaturation.

art.note: 카페 — 창빛이 긴 그림자를 만드는 낡은 참나무 상판
art.prompt: Editorial photograph, 35mm on Kodak Portra 400. Hard afternoon sun rakes across a scratched oak counter from a window at the left and throws one long shadow of a hand-thrown ceramic dripper. A few beans have rolled out of frame. A crumpled coffee-stained linen cloth is pushed to the right edge. Visible film grain, cool shadows against warm highlights, nothing arranged symmetrically, the upper two thirds is bare wall falling out of focus.

art.note: 학원 — 중세기 폴란드 책표지풍 실크스크린
art.prompt: Screen-printed poster illustration in the manner of mid-century Polish book covers. A stack of books, a ruler and two pencils built entirely from flat geometric shapes along the bottom edge. Four inks only — deep navy, warm cream, muted coral and their overprint — with visible misregistration and paper grain. No outlines, no gradients, no shading. Generous empty cream above.

art.note: 필라테스 — 창살 그림자가 바닥에 길게 눕는 새벽 스튜디오
art.prompt: Editorial interior photograph, 28mm, early morning. A pilates reformer in matte black and pale ash wood sits low in the right of the frame, its leather straps hanging slack. Low hard sun through a tall industrial window throws long window-bar shadows across a pale concrete floor. Cool grey shadow, warm sunlit patches, dust suspended in the light. Nobody present. The upper half is bare plaster wall.

art.note: 제철 채소 — 젖은 종이에 번진 과슈, 흘러내린 자국까지
art.prompt: Loose gouache and watercolour study on cold-press paper, painted wet into wet: napa cabbage, spring onion, a red chili and a head of garlic massed along the bottom edge, the paint bleeding and running off the bottom and both sides, a few dry-brush strokes and one accidental drip. Muted sage, terracotta and ochre. Visible paper tooth. The upper two thirds untouched warm white.

art.note: 쿠폰 — 크라프트 종이 질감
art.prompt: Flat scan of warm tan kraft paper, fine fibre speckles, even soft lighting, no shadows, no objects, subtle vignette at the very edges only.

art.note: 뷰티 — 파스텔 곡선 도형
art.prompt: Minimal composition of two overlapping soft arcs in dusty pink and pale sand on an off-white field, matte finish, no gradient banding, shapes confined to the left third, rest empty.

art.note: 공연 — 빈 무대에 떨어지는 텅스텐 조명 하나
art.prompt: Editorial photograph taken from the back of a small concert hall, 50mm, long exposure. One warm tungsten spotlight falls on an empty wooden stage holding four folding chairs and a music stand, casting sharp raking shadows. The seating in the foreground is deep blue-black and almost featureless. Heavy 35mm grain, teal shadows against amber highlight, the upper half nearly pure black.

art.note: 축제 — 밤 장터의 등과 천막
art.prompt: Flat vector illustration of a night market: paper lanterns, striped awnings and simple rooftops along the bottom quarter, silkscreen texture, four flat colours (ink navy, warm yellow, coral, cream), no outlines, wide empty sky above.

art.note: 병원·약국 — 차분한 기하 도형
art.prompt: Flat graphic filling the entire frame: one large pale blue circle placed low and to the right, one thin horizontal band of soft mint crossing beneath it, plain white everywhere else, matte flat colour, no gradient. Edge to edge artwork, no frame, no mockup, no shadow, no paper sheet, no border.

art.note: 종교·단체 행사 — 창으로 드는 빛 수채화
art.prompt: Watercolour wash filling the entire frame: warm light falling through a tall arched window onto pale stone, dusty gold and warm grey, the wash runs off all four edges, the upper area left almost white, paper grain visible. Edge to edge artwork, no paper sheet, no frame, no border, no vignette, no figures.

art.note: 모집 공고 — 거친 종이와 옅은 격자
art.prompt: Close photograph of coarse recycled paper in warm off-white, faint printed grid lines showing through, uneven fibre texture, even flat lighting, no objects.

art.note: 개업 — 화환의 국화와 리본이 왼쪽 끝만 잘려 들어옴
art.prompt: Editorial still life, 85mm, against a deep crimson painted wall. At the left edge, a dense mass of white and yellow chrysanthemums and satin ribbon from a Korean congratulatory flower wreath, cropped so only part of it enters the frame. Hard side light from the left throws a sharp shadow rightward across the wall. Rich saturated red, slightly cool shadow, visible paint texture. The right two thirds is uninterrupted wall.

art.note: 음식점 — 낡은 나무 상에 오른 뚝배기 국밥
art.prompt: Editorial food photograph, 50mm, low warm side light from the right. A Korean earthenware ttukbaegi of steaming pork gukbap sits at the far right of a worn dark wooden table, steam caught against the dark background, a battered brass spoon and a small dish of kimchi beside it. Rich browns and deep reds, honest and unstyled, a little messy. The left half falls into near-black shadow.

art.note: 세일 — 강한 대비의 사선 띠
art.prompt: Bold minimal composition: three thick diagonal bands in saffron yellow, off-black and white sweeping across the left quarter of a wide field, hard flat edges, high contrast, remainder a single flat off-black plane.

art.note: 부동산 — 겨울 하늘 아래 아파트 모서리, 빛과 그늘로 갈린 면
art.prompt: Editorial architectural photograph, 24mm shift lens, looking up the corner of a Korean apartment tower against a clear pale winter sky. Late afternoon sun rakes across the concrete and splits the facade into one bright plane and one cool shadowed plane. Balconies read as a strict repeating grid. Muted concrete grey and pale blue, no clouds. The building occupies only the lower third.

art.note: 뷰티 — 흐린 꽃 수채화 기둥
art.prompt: Vertical watercolour of pale peonies and eucalyptus trailing down the right edge, dusty rose and sage on white paper, soft bleeding edges, paper grain, the left two thirds untouched white.

art.note: 헬스 — 굵은 세로 도형
art.prompt: Vertical minimal composition: one enormous soft arc of deep indigo rising from the bottom edge over a pale grey field, matte flat colour, no gradient banding, upper half completely empty.

art.note: 병원 — 북향 창빛이 흰 벽에 부드럽게 번지는 대기 구석
art.prompt: Editorial interior photograph, 35mm, a quiet clinic waiting corner. A pale oak bench holds one folded grey blanket; a monstera leaf enters from the lower left. Soft north light from a window out of frame lays a gentle gradient across a white plaster wall. Calm and slightly desaturated, warm wood against cool white. The upper two thirds is empty wall.

art.note: 리넨 — 사광에 씨실이 그림자를 만드는 무염색 아마천
art.prompt: Macro photograph of undyed ivory linen. Raking light from the top left so the weave casts real micro-shadow; a few slubs and irregular threads are visible; one soft fold runs out of the bottom right corner. Warm neutral, matte, no synthetic sheen, no styling.

art.note: 메뉴판 — 짙은 호두나무
art.prompt: Dark walnut wood surface photographed straight on, fine straight grain, warm low light falling from the top left, deep brown, no objects, no reflections.

art.note: 한식당 — 재료 수채화 띠
art.prompt: Loose watercolour band of Korean ingredients across the top quarter: dried red pepper, garlic, sesame leaves, soft bleeding edges on warm white paper, muted red and green, the rest of the page left white.

art.note: 카페 — 커피 도구 플랫 일러스트
art.prompt: Flat vector illustration of coffee tools in a row along the bottom: moka pot, dripper, scale, cup, thick simple geometric forms, three colours only (espresso brown, cream, muted teal), no outlines, generous cream space above.

art.note: 다이닝 — 어두운 대리석
art.prompt: Dark charcoal marble slab photographed straight on, subtle pale veining, matte surface, even soft light, no objects, no reflections, deep neutral tone.

art.note: 공용 장식 — 가는 잎 한 줄기
art.prompt: A single slender olive branch drawn in one continuous thin black ink line, centred on plain white that fills the entire frame, generous margin around the branch. Edge to edge white, no frame, no border, no paper sheet, no shadow.
